scope: Four fresh paired rounds. Three sequential edits within each round; edit samples are not independent rounds. Wall time is whole Cargo command; allocated bytes are inode-deduplicated post-command target+build+scratch, not peak disk.

metric_definitions.wall: Whole Cargo command including process startup/wait; excludes post-command oracle/census
metric_definitions.cpu: GNU time user+system seconds, aggregate child CPU
metric_definitions.sampled_tree_rss: Maximum of 0.5-second sampled sum of live descendants RSS; not PSS/unique physical pages
metric_definitions.max_child_rss: GNU time maximum child RSS; not simultaneous sum
metric_definitions.allocated: Post-command target/build/scratch lane st_blocks*512 with hardlink inode deduplication; no external store, not peak disk or unique CoW extents
